answer_1.quote: we introduce an argument reconstruction task that simulates expert writing through evidence retrieval and structured argument generation over full-length argumentative articles
datasets: 600 high-quality argumentative articles from authoritative Chinese think tanks

answer_2.quote: To quantitatively evaluate performance, we introduce two novel metrics: claim coverage and evidence coverage, [...] we report ROUGE scores and entity recall over the full article

answer_3.quote: Furthermore, we prompt two advanced LLMs, GPT-4o and DeepSeek-R1, to evaluate each reconstructed article relative to its original across five key dimensions: Relevance, Structure, Coverage, Accuracy, and Coherence, using a 5-point rubric

answer_4.quote: we conducted a human evaluation in collaboration with five experienced intelligence experts
answer_4.guideline: Experts rated reconstructions on five dimensions: Relevance, Structure, Coverage, Accuracy, and Coherence using a 5-point scale
